brief: Craft over hustle: 6 things makers know that hustlers don't.

slots.scriptTagline: Six quiet truths the hustle never learned

slots.body: Hustlers wear exhaustion like a badge. Makers know recovery is where ideas incubate and quality is born. Rest is not the opposite of craft; it is part of it.
Hustlers chase endless options and scale before structure. Makers impose constraints to sharpen vision and deepen the work. Less becomes the lever for more.
Hustlers broadcast before they build. Makers trust that substance creates its own signal. One finished piece outweighs a thousand empty announcements.
Speed is the hustler's metric. Makers move deliberately, knowing that depth compounds while velocity fades. The slow path builds what lasts.
Hustlers say yes to every demand. Makers protect their focus because every yes to distraction is a no to the craft.
Hustlers optimize for vanity numbers. Makers measure by endurance, creating work that outlives algorithms and trends. Legacy is the only metric.
